title: "Teaching & Workshops"
---

This page collects teaching materials, workshop handouts, presentations, and instructional resources developed for training junior researchers and clinical staff in biostatistics and data science.

---

## Presentations

### Margins in Stata
*April 2023 · Mount Sinai Hospital*

A practical workshop covering the `margins` command in Stata — APM, PMM, PMR, AME, MEM, MER, interactions, and dummy variables. Includes worked examples using NHANES II, GSS, and Medicare claims data.

🖥️ **[View Presentation](margins-stata.qmd)**

---

### Research Use of Medicare Prescription Drug Event (PDE) Data
*December 2025 · Mount Sinai Hospital*

An overview of CMS Medicare Part D Prescription Drug Event data — what it captures, its limitations, core variables, NDC codes, brand vs. generic naming, and how researchers link PDE with other Medicare files for pharmacoepidemiology and drug utilization research.

🖥️ **[View Presentation](pde-medicare.qmd)**

## Weekly Huddle Statistics Workshops

**Mount Sinai Hospital — Geriatrics & Palliative Care**

I run weekly statistics workshops ("huddles") for the research team at Mount Sinai, covering practical applied biostatistics using Stata. Topics are driven by real analytical challenges encountered in our research projects.

📂 [View All Workshop Materials on GitHub](https://github.com/honoluluhan717/huddle-workshops){target="_blank"}
